job.name: l4_host_b2
job.meaning: мужчина ~32, фудблогер-шеф: тёмные кудри, аккуратные усы, очки в прозрачной оправе, горчичная рубашка с закатанными рукавами и зелёный льняной фартук; фон — свежий зелёный; яркая модная рекламная фотосессия в палитре «Свежий рынок», харизматичный и красивый человек; по пояс, по центру, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки; без надписей
job.prompt: High-end fashion-editorial / advertising campaign photograph, vertical 9:16, waist-up, the person in the centre facing the camera, shoulders square, hands out of frame. The person is strikingly attractive, charismatic, stylish, with a memorable look — like the face of a trendy lifestyle brand campaign, NOT a stock photo. Expression: confident and alive but NEUTRAL, like in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile, eyes straight into the lens with a spark. Headroom: top of the head about 16% of the frame height below the upper edge; the face is large and razor-sharp. Colour world from the attached board «Свежий рынок» (palette only, do NOT copy the man on it): leaf green #23A455, tomato red #FF4B2E, mustard yellow #FFC531, cream #FFF6E9. Bright, saturated, glossy commercial lighting: a soft beauty key light on the face plus a coloured rim/background light; vivid but flattering skin tones, natural skin texture. No text, no logos, no brand names, no badges, no headphones, no hats or sunglasses covering the face. A man of about 32, Slavic features, voluminous dark curly hair, a neat moustache and light stubble, stylish clear-frame glasses, wearing a mustard-yellow overshirt with rolled sleeves and a leaf-green linen apron over it. Background: a seamless fresh leaf-green #23A455 backdrop with a soft lighter halo behind his head.
